feature_definition.availability: Assume raw purchase/approval, original promise, static customer/seller states and item prices/sequences are available at approval. Export has no ingestion/revision timestamps; no promise as-of revision claim. Static geolocation assumption unchanged for XGBoost geo backbone.
feature_definition.raw_population: All raw orders with non-null purchase/approval and approval >= purchase, including cancelled and unfinished orders; arrival features never read final status, actual delivery or target. Invalid promises still count for routes but not route/promise lanes.
feature_definition.route_key: primary seller state plus customer state; primary seller is highest item price with item sequence tie-break as in existing history builder; missing keys stay missing and are never pooled
feature_definition.promise_days: original estimated-delivery calendar date minus approval calendar date; nonnegative integer days only for lanes and promise crosses
feature_definition.lane_key: route key plus fixed promise bin

windows.boundary_policy: lower endpoint included; upper endpoint excluded; exclude all approvals tied at query timestamp including current order

feature_definition.growth_formula: log((recent count+1)/(previous count+1)) for route and route/promise lane, separately at7 and14 days; known routes/lanes without past events have zero counts and zero log growth
feature_definition.share_change_formula: route recent7/global recent7 minus route previous7/global previous7; each global denominator includes all valid raw approvals, regardless of state/promise; zero denominator means missing share/change

cross_categorical_formulas.state_route_promise_bin: state_route|promise_bin; missing if either route state or promise invalid
cross_categorical_formulas.state_route_promise_growth_bin: state_route|promise_bin|lane growth direction; increase if lane7 log growth > log1.25, decrease if < -log1.25, otherwise stable including boundaries

feature_definition.preprocessing: Train-only numeric median/missing indicators (plus StandardScaler for Logistic) and categorical most-frequent/OneHotEncoder min_frequency20, unknown ignore; existing backbone contract unchanged.
feature_definition.package_contrast: trend adds13 numeric features; cross includes trend plus4 numeric and2 categorical interactions; all old91 features/metadata remain in frozen cache but model whitelists exclude dispatch

policies.fit: same monthly deadline-clock wait0 training IDs, sorted approval/order-ID rows and train-only preprocessing as the corresponding frozen backbone
policies.historical_scores: each historical month uses its own monthly model; never final-model rescores of training rows
policies.ranking: uncalibrated score descending then order_id ascending; threshold zero, fill daily floor(10% * complete eligible scored batch)
policies.label_maturity: historical validation outcomes strictly before E; unknown labels still compete for full-batch slots
policies.selection: maximize worst recall of three known-label historical months, then pooled TP, pooled raw AP, fixed candidate order
policies.floor: 30% each historical month is a diagnostic suitability gate; no future recall guarantee
policies.search: six predeclared cells: Logistic load C1/C.01 and XGBoost geo, each with trend and cross variants; backbone parameters unchanged; no new regularization grid or evaluation early stopping
policies.comparison: delivery_wait0 versus deadline_wait0 isolates training maturity clock at fixed model/wait; deadline_wait0 versus deadline_wait30 changes training approval wait; old 60-day models provide background only
policies.features: trend adds13 causal numeric history/approval-load changes; cross adds4 numeric and2 categorical route/promise/load interactions; no target encoding or dispatch additions
policies.probabilities: classifier scores uncalibrated; ranker sigmoid is a monotone numerical interface conversion, not probability calibration; reject saturation that collapses distinct margins
policies.evaluation_role: all E months and design have been informed by repeatedly inspected development results; pre-fit specification does not make these periods independent tests
policies.coverage: eligible valid eventually-delivered cohort only; not every originally approved order
policies.batch_timing: complete closed calendar-day batches required; up to one day wait; no per-order online cap guarantee
policies.promotion: new artifacts remain research only; original and prior research models preserved
policies.visualization: no dashboard or new plots in this experiment; user requested ranking work first
policies.pending_limit: no cancellation timestamp available; approved cancelled orders can remain pending inside the 30/90-day windows; static master-table location assumption
policies.ranker: fixed backbone classifiers; old50 candidates are verified/replayed and never refit; no new calibration or threshold
policies.training_clock: delivery clock is actual delivery; deadline clock is min(actual delivery, midnight after promised calendar date); original actual-delivery metadata and history unchanged
policies.clock_limit: eventual-delivery cohort remains retrospectively selected; no cancellation outcome labels inferred; assumes original promise date and immediate delivery event availability
policies.paired_comparison: baseline versus trend isolates the trend package; trend versus cross isolates the four numeric and two categorical crosses, holding training IDs, row order and estimator parameters fixed
policies.geolocation: seventh file treated as static postal reference available at approval; paired-valid-coordinate per-ZIP median, great-circle distance not road distance; no as-of version metadata or result-based coordinate clipping
policies.dispatch_availability: no dispatch candidates reused or fitted in this round; frozen preceding sensitivity report retained
policies.primary_selection: previous50 plus new6; selectors previous_candidates, new_route_load, primary_without_dispatch; maximize worst of three historical month recalls then pooled TP/AP/fixed order
policies.solver: Logistic retains L2/lbfgs C1 or C.01/max_iter10000; reject ConvergenceWarning or n_iter >= max_iter; solver diagnostics never select models
